# @classytic/media-kit

Media engine for Mongoose and arc: storage providers, presigned uploads, dedup, variants, private signed serving. Skill: skills/media-kit/SKILL.md.
Verbs live on `engine.repositories.media` (a mongokit Repository), not on the engine.

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| Create the engine | `defineMedia(shape).bind(connection, runtime)` |
| Local disk (dev) | `LocalProvider` from `@classytic/media-kit/providers/local` |
| GCS bucket | `GCSProvider` from `@classytic/media-kit/providers/gcs` (set `makePublic: false` for private) |
| S3, R2, MinIO | `S3Provider` from `@classytic/media-kit/providers/s3` |
| Several backends by key prefix | `StorageRouter` from `@classytic/media-kit/providers/router` |
| Browser uploads straight to storage | `repo.getSignedUploadUrl`, then `repo.confirmUpload` |
| Multipart or resumable large files | `repo.initiateMultipartUpload`, `createTusUpload` |
| Skip uploading a known file | `deduplication` config, `repo.existsByHash` |
| Private file, expiring link | `repo.getSignedAssetUrl`, `repo.revokeAccess`, `signing` config |
| Serve route with Range and variants | `createAssetTransform` from `@classytic/media-kit/transforms` |
| Sign URLs outside the engine | `createUrlSigner` from `@classytic/media-kit/signing` |
| Thumbnails, webp, ThumbHash | `processing` config (needs `sharp`) |
| Per-tenant storage quota | `createMongoStorageBudget` from `@classytic/media-kit/storage-budget/mongo` |
| Delete media with its owner | `withMediaCascade` |
| Block deleting referenced media | `bridges.usage` |
| Image for a vision model | `repo.getContextPayload` |
| Third-party URL as a record | `repo.registerExternal` |
| Validate request bodies | `uploadInputSchema`, `confirmUploadSchema` from `@classytic/media-kit/schemas` |
| React to uploads | `MEDIA_EVENTS` via `engine.events.subscribe` |
| Map failures | `MEDIA_ERROR_CODES` |
| Scheduled cleanup | `repo.purgeDeleted`, `repo.purgeStalePending`, `repo.purgeExpired` |

Details: references/uploads.md, serving-private.md, engine-config.md. Client compression: skill media-transform.
